evals.prompt: This feature needs legal validation before we turn it on. Write the contract clause draft for the lawyer.
evals.expected_output: Writes a versioned draft with pending-legal front matter, a not-legal-advice disclaimer, objective, point of attention, numbered clauses describing only built behavior, and open questions; keeps the feature gated and does not call the draft approved.

evals.prompt: Gather everything that still needs the lawyer's opinion so I can send it all at once on WhatsApp.
evals.expected_output: Searches drafts, tracker issues and decision records, reads each candidate, lists shipped items that skipped a requested validation first, and builds one PDF with a cover of grouped questions plus the drafts; gives the file path and does not send it on the user's behalf.

evals.prompt: The lawyer can't open the GitHub link to the draft.
